title: Aerodynamics
description: Aerodynamics as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Does the installation affect any external aerodynamic surface?
Are any external protrusions, inlets, outlets or drains identified and their positions agreed?
Are aerodynamic loads on externally exposed items estimated for the flight envelope?
Are external mould line changes, steps and gaps within the agreed aerodynamic tolerances?
Are inlet and outlet flows (vents, drains, cooling air) assessed for effect on drag and local flow?
Are aerodynamic loads provided to Structural Analysis for the preliminary sizing?
Are surface finish, step and gap tolerances on the external surface stated on the drawings?
Are final aerodynamic loads confirmed against the released aerodynamic data set?
Are any items in disturbed flow (for example behind protrusions) assessed for buffet and fatigue?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
